summary: Dr. Knock (original title "Knock") is a 1951 French comedy film directed by Guy Lefranc with a screenplay by Georges Neveux and Louis Jouvet in the lead role. Louis de Funès makes an uncredited appearance. The film adapts Jules Romains's 1923 stage play "Knock ou le Triomphe de la médecine".
one_line: A 1951 French comedy film directed by Guy Lefranc, adapting Jules Romains's 1923 play about the doctor Knock.
key_facts: Dr. Knock (original title "Knock") is a French comedy film from 1951.
The film was directed by Guy Lefranc.
The film was written by Georges Neveux.
Louis de Funès has an uncredited appearance in the film.
The film is based on the 1923 theatre play "Knock ou le Triomphe de la médecine".
The English title of the 1923 play is "Knock or The Triumph of Medicine".
The 1923 play was written by Jules Romains.
